dslRule:
<!id: swt.link.noWrap>
<!description: Replace SWT.WRAP with SWT.NONE for org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Link constructors to prevent text wrapping.
This aligns with a policy to avoid wrapping for Link widgets, improving display consistency.>
<!severity: WARNING>

new org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Link($parent$, org.eclipse.swt.SWT.WRAP)
=>
new org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Link($parent$, org.eclipse.swt.SWT.NONE)
;;
summary: Replaces the SWT.WRAP style constant with SWT.NONE when creating an org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Link widget, based on an observed project policy.
